author: Seung Wook
problem: lines are the lines of a weather balloon's radio packet. Each data line holds one whole-number reading, blank lines are padding, and the line 'END' marks the end of the packet; anything after it is noise. Return the sum of the readings.
bug_description: Uses break instead of continue on a blank line, so padding in the middle of a packet cuts it short.

comments.accurate: Sum of the readings in the packet, up to its END line
comments.wrong_behavior: Sum of the readings up to the first gap or END line
comments.wrong_location: End-of-packet check verified; check each line is stripped before it is read
